title: Certificates of Deposit: grace period length and grace-period allowances by tier
content:
## Scope

This card covers the grace period that follows the maturity date of every Certificates of Deposit tier: how many calendar days it lasts, and which penalty-free actions each tier allows during it, namely adding money, withdrawing part of the balance and renewing into a different tier.

## Definitions

- **Grace period length** is the number of calendar days after the maturity date during which the owner may add, withdraw or change term without penalty.
- **Grace add-ons allowed** states whether deposits may be added during the grace period.
- **Smallest grace add-on** is the smallest single deposit accepted during the grace period, in USD.
- **Most added per grace period** is the most that may be added in total during one grace period, in USD.
- **Grace partial withdrawal allowed** states whether part of the balance may be withdrawn penalty-free during the grace period.
- **Grace term change allowed** states whether the owner may renew into a different certificate tier during the grace period.

## Allowances by tier

| Tier | Grace period length (calendar days) | Grace add-ons allowed | Smallest single grace add-on (USD) | Most added in total per grace period (USD) | Grace partial withdrawal allowed | Grace term change allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | 10 | Yes | 100.00 | 250000.00 | Yes | Yes |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | 10 | Yes | 100.00 | 250000.00 | Yes | Yes |
| 12-Month Certificate | 10 | Yes | 100.00 | 250000.00 | Yes | Yes |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | 10 | Yes | 100.00 | 250000.00 | Yes | Yes |
| 36-Month Certificate | 10 | Yes | 100.00 | 250000.00 | Yes | Yes |
| 60-Month Certificate | 10 | Yes | 100.00 | 250000.00 | Yes | Yes |

## The same allowances, stated once for the whole line

At present the grace settings are identical across the six tiers: a grace period of 10 calendar days after the maturity date; grace add-ons allowed, each single deposit at least 100.00 USD and no more than 250000.00 USD in total for one grace period; partial withdrawals allowed; and renewal into a different tier allowed.

## Points of judgement

**Is 250000.00 USD a limit on each grace deposit?**
No. It is the most that may be added in total during one grace period. The per-deposit limit is the smallest single deposit of 100.00 USD.

**A hypothetical owner adds 150000.00 USD early in the grace period and then asks to add another 120000.00 USD. Does the second deposit fit the total?**
No. Together the two would come to 270000.00 USD, which is more than the 250000.00 USD most that may be added in one grace period. A second deposit of up to 100000.00 USD would fit the total.

**Is a single grace deposit of 99.00 USD accepted?**
No. It is below the smallest single grace add-on of 100.00 USD.
